title: FineDeb: A Debiasing Framework for Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models using StereoSet (intrasentence stereotype score and language modeling score), Crow-S Pairs (preference for stereotypical vs. anti-stereotypical sentence pairs), and SEAT (Sentence Encoder Association Test measuring average effect size between attribute and target word embeddings).
